content.name: Jordan Avery
content.subject: Re: Online Program Developer
content.greeting: Dear Tallgrass Technical Institute hiring team,
paragraphs: I'm applying for the Online Program Developer role because it centers on the work I do best: building online courses that are clear, accessible, and reviewed before they reach students.
At Northfield Community College I introduced a shared review checklist that cut average review rounds from 3 to 2 across 40 courses.
In one term I brought 120 course pages to the institution's accessibility standard, working through each page with faculty.
I'd bring careful design, measured improvement, and a habit of documenting what works so a team can repeat it.
